'''Shelvin Mack''' (born April 22, 1990) was an [[United States|American]] [[college basketball]] player for the [[Butler Bulldogs men's basketball|Butler Bulldogs]]. 

In 2011, Mack help lead the Bulldogs to the [[2011 NCAA Men's Division I Basketball Championship]] game. He declared for the [[2011 NBA Draft]], to be held June 23, following his junior year.
